plugins.description: Agent skills that teach Claude, Cursor, and other AI agents to read web analytics like a senior analyst. Diagnose traffic changes, judge channel quality, and read funnels without the usual rookie mistakes. Works with any analytics source; first-class support for Clamp MCP.

skills.name: analytics-diagnostic-method
skills.description: The spine of analytics investigation. Use whenever interpreting analytics numbers, answering "why did X change", reading funnels, comparing cohorts, or presenting findings. Teaches a five-step method (load profile, frame the question, build a MECE hypothesis tree, triangulate, present with Pyramid Principle), how to separate signal from noise, and how to spot Simpson's paradox before it misleads you.
headings: Don't fall back to manual data entry
1. Load the profile and frame the question
Simpson's paradox: the trap that catches most agents
How to use the other skills
skills.description_zh: 提供分析调查五步法：加载画像、界定问题、构建 MECE 假设树、交叉验证、按金字塔原则呈现。用于解释指标变化、漏斗、群体比较和结论，区分信号噪声并识别辛普森悖论。

skills.name: analytics-profile-setup
skills.description: One-time interview that captures the business context (industry, model, primary conversion, traffic range, ICP, data stack) into a local analytics-profile.md file. Every other analytics skill reads this file so its answers are calibrated to the right benchmarks and terminology instead of generic averages.
headings: Phase 1. Check for an existing profile
skills.description_zh: 一次性访谈采集行业、业务模式、主要转化、流量范围、理想客户和数据栈，保存本地 analytics-profile.md；其他分析技能据此匹配基准与术语。

skills.name: anomaly-detection-time-series
skills.description: Formal time-series methods that augment the hand-coded fingerprint library in traffic-change-diagnosis. Use this skill when traffic-change-diagnosis fingerprints overlap, when the user asks "is this real?", or when the change date is contested. Applies STL decomposition, Bayesian online changepoint detection, Prophet, quantile regression, sequential probability ratio test, and Granger causality. Use whenever interpreting a series where day-of-week confounds an eyeballed drop, where two candidate causes share a week, or where an alert needs to fire before an analyst sees the chart. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method for the surrounding investigation and with sequential-monitoring for the SPRT details. Triggers when Clamp MCP traffic_timeseries returns a series spanning more than 14 days, or when via Clamp the user shares a daily/hourly metric history that needs a non-eyeball verdict.
headings: Method 2. Bayesian online changepoint detection (Adams & MacKay 2007)
Method 4. Quantile regression for anomaly scoring
Worked example: 30-day traffic series, eyeballed drop on day 14
Worked example: two fingerprints fit, BOCD breaks the tie
What to ask the user before running anything
Workflow: from fingerprint conflict to formal verdict
skills.description_zh: 用 STL、贝叶斯在线变点、Prophet、分位数回归、序贯概率比检验和 Granger 因果方法增强流量变化诊断。用于指纹重叠、变化是否真实或日期争议、星期效应、同期候选原因及早期告警；Clamp 返回超过 14 天序列或用户提供需严谨判断的日/小时历史时适用，配合诊断法和序贯监控。

skills.name: bayesian-experiment-reader
skills.description: Bayesian counterpart to experiment-result-reader. Computes posterior P(variant beats control), credible intervals, and expected loss from per-variant exposure and conversion data. Beta-Binomial for proportion metrics (CVR), Normal-Normal for continuous metrics (revenue per user). Decision rule combines a confidence threshold with an expected-loss tolerance, so the ship decision reflects both "how likely is this better?" and "how bad is it if I'm wrong?". Use this skill alongside experiment-result-reader when reading any A/B test result. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method. Use whenever interpreting an A/B test result the user plans to ship from, when the question is "what's the chance variant wins?", or when a frequentist p-value is on the edge and the user wants the posterior view. Triggers when Clamp MCP returns experiment exposure and conversion data, or when any analytics source surfaces per-variant counts.
headings: Why Bayesian beats frequentist for shipping decisions
Phase 2A. Beta-Binomial workflow for proportion metrics
Phase 2B. Normal-Normal workflow for continuous metrics
Phase 4. Sanity-check against the frequentist read
Worked example: CVR test, clear ship
Worked example: frequentist says ship, Bayesian says hold
skills.description_zh: 与 experiment-result-reader 配合，以各变体曝光与转化计算胜过对照的后验概率、可信区间和预期损失；比例用 Beta-Binomial，连续指标用 Normal-Normal。结合信心阈值与损失容忍度给决策，用于即将上线的 A/B 结果、胜出概率或边界 p 值的贝叶斯视角；适用 Clamp 或其他来源的逐变体计数。

skills.name: causal-dag-builder
skills.description: Build a refinable causal DAG before answering "did X cause Y" on observational data. Emits a Mermaid diagram of assumed causes, applies the back-door criterion to decide what to condition on, and forces confounders, mediators, and colliders to be named explicitly instead of "controlling for everything". The DAG is an artifact downstream skills read to pick the right adjustment set. Use whenever interpreting cohort comparisons, funnel drop-offs, or any analytics result where the user is reasoning causally without an experiment. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method as the causal-structure layer underneath the diagnostic tree. Triggers when Clamp MCP cohorts_compare or funnels_create is called with no experimental holdback, when a Clamp MCP result prompts a causal claim from observational data, or when via Clamp the user asks "why did this segment convert higher".
headings: What a DAG is, in 100 words
Phase 3. Draw the minimal DAG in Mermaid
Phase 5. Hand the adjustment set to the next skill
skills.description_zh: 在用观察数据判断因果前建立可修订 Mermaid 因果 DAG，用后门准则确定调整变量，明确混杂、媒介和碰撞变量，供下游选调整集。用于无实验对照的群体差异、漏斗流失或因果解释，配合分析诊断法；涵盖 Clamp 群体比较及漏斗。

skills.name: causal-evidence-checklist
skills.description: Bradford Hill's 9 viewpoints (1965) reframed as a checklist for product analytics. Use this skill before recommending a decision based on observational analytics data. Applies the 9 Bradford Hill viewpoints to score whether X actually caused Y, or whether the correlation is coincidental, confounded, or reversed. Use whenever interpreting a metric change the user is about to act on (rollback, ship, abandon, double-down). Refuses to label a verdict "high confidence" when fewer than ~5 of the 9 criteria pass. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method (which provides the hypothesis tree) and channel-and-funnel-quality (which provides the segmentation discipline). Triggers when Clamp MCP returns a comparison the user is about to act on, when a deploy correlates with a metric move, or when the user says "X caused Y" / "did X cause Y" / "should we roll back / ship / kill X" based on a chart. Vendor-neutral methodology; via Clamp MCP the per-criterion checks map directly to traffic.compare, traffic.breakdown, errors.timeline, and funnels.list.
headings: Phase 4. Refusal rule (the part agents skip)
Phase 5. Present with the Pyramid Principle
Worked example: "bounce rate jumped after the Tuesday deploy"
Variant A — weak evidence, refuse the rollback
Variant B — well-supported, ship the rollback
skills.description_zh: 在依据观察分析建议回滚、上线、放弃或扩大前，用 Bradford Hill 九视角检查 X 是否导致 Y，区分偶然、混杂及反向因果；约少于五项通过时不标高信心。配合诊断树及渠道漏斗细分，适用于发布与指标变化关联，方法不依赖供应商，Clamp 可映射到流量比较拆分、错误时间线和漏斗。

skills.name: causal-query-classifier
skills.description: Pearl's three-rung causal hierarchy as a query classifier. Tags every analytics question as rung-1 (association, P(Y|X)), rung-2 (intervention, P(Y|do(X))), or rung-3 (counterfactual, P(Y_x|Y',X')) before answering. Refuses to escalate a rung-1 observational finding into a rung-2 ship/kill recommendation without naming an identification strategy (back-door, instrumental variable, DiD, RDD, synthetic control). Use this skill whenever interpreting an analytics question that asks why or what-if, to classify it on Pearl's causal hierarchy before answering. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method. Triggers when Clamp MCP returns a comparison or trend that the user is about to act on, so the agent labels the claim's rung explicitly instead of laundering correlation into causation. Works with any observational source; Clamp MCP is the canonical integration via traffic.compare, funnels.list, and cohorts.compare.
headings: Background: Pearl's three rungs in plain language
Decision table: question shape → rung → strategies
Step 1. Restate the question and tag its rung
Step 2. Check what data is available
Step 4. If a strategy is available, name it and run it
Step 5. Report with the rung explicitly tagged
Worked example: "Did the new pricing page lift CVR?"
Worked example: "Will pricing-page V2 lift CVR?" (forward-looking)
skills.description_zh: 回答为什么或假设问题前，按 Pearl 三层因果层级标为关联、干预或反事实。无后门、工具变量、双重差分、断点或合成控制等识别策略时，不把观察关联升级成上线或停止建议。配合诊断法，适用于用户将依据趋势或比较采取行动；可用任意观察来源，Clamp 为典型集成。

skills.name: channel-and-funnel-quality
skills.description: Judge whether traffic is actually valuable and whether funnel drop-off is real or expected. Use when comparing marketing channels, reading a conversion funnel, or deciding where to invest. Covers volume × engagement × conversion as a matrix, vanity-traffic detection, expected step drop-off by funnel type, cohort decomposition, and mix-shift (Simpson's paradox) handling.

Landing page conversion (Unbounce *Conversion Benchmark Report 2024*, 57M conversions, 41k+ pages)

skills.description_zh: 判断流量是否有价值及漏斗流失是否真实或预期，结合流量×互动×转化矩阵、虚荣流量、漏斗类型正常流失、群体拆分和混合结构变化（辛普森悖论）；用于渠道比较、漏斗解读和投资决策。

skills.name: event-schema-author
skills.description: Author and maintain an event-schema.yaml file. A portable, typed declaration of every product analytics event the codebase fires (event names, properties, types, intent). The CLI generates a TypeScript type from it so tracking calls are autocompleted and type-checked at build time. Vendor-neutral; works with any analytics SDK (Clamp, GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Segment).
headings: Generic; most analytics SDKs expose a track() function
Phase 3. The intent question (do not skip)
Phase 4. Write the file and run the CLI
Phase 5. Wire the generated type into call sites

skills.description_zh: 编写维护可移植、类型化 event-schema.yaml，定义产品事件名称、属性、类型和意图；CLI 生成 TypeScript 类型，使跟踪调用可补全并在构建时校验。适用于 Clamp、GA4、Mixpanel、Amplitude、PostHog 和 Segment 等任意 SDK。

skills.name: experiment-result-reader
skills.description: Read the result of a running A/B test honestly. Pulls per-variant exposure and conversion counts, computes lift, applies sequential-testing and sample-size discipline, and surfaces the result in plain language without over-claiming. Built on the experiments section of the event-schema spec; works with any platform that fires a canonical exposure event ($exposure, $experiment_started, or equivalent).
headings: Phase 3. Compute lift, but caveat it correctly
Phase 4. Look for what could explain the result *other than* the variant
Phase 5. Present with the Pyramid Principle
skills.description_zh: 读取运行中 A/B 测试的逐变体曝光与转化，计算提升，遵守序贯检验和样本量约束并通俗说明，避免夸大。依据 event-schema 实验规范，适用于发送 $exposure、$experiment_started 或等价标准曝光事件的平台。

skills.name: metric-context-and-benchmarks
skills.description: Interpret analytics metrics with correct context. Use when the user asks "is this good", "what's a normal X", or quotes a rate without denominator. Covers realistic ranges for bounce rate, engagement, session duration, pages per session, conversion rate by model type, SaaS unit economics (LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MRR churn, activation, retention), plus when each metric lies and minimum sample sizes.
skills.name_hint: 指标 · 上下文 · and · 对标
skills.description_zh: 在正确业务语境下解释指标和基准，适用于好不好、正常范围及缺分母的比率。涵盖跳出、互动、会话时长、浏览页数、分模式转化率，以及 SaaS 的 LTV:CAC、回收期、MRR 流失、激活和留存，并说明误导条件和最低样本量。

skills.name: sequential-monitoring
skills.description: Always-valid sequential inference for honest peeking at running A/B tests. Applies mSPRT (mixture Sequential Probability Ratio Test) or confidence sequences so the false-positive rate stays at the nominal alpha even when the test is checked daily. Use this skill when the user asks if it's safe to call an A/B test early, or to peek-check a running test. Pairs with experiment-result-reader and bayesian-experiment-reader, and with analytics-diagnostic-method for the framing discipline. Triggers when Clamp MCP returns mid-experiment exposure and conversion counts, or when a user references peeking, early stopping, sequential testing, alpha-spending, mSPRT, or confidence sequences. Vendor-neutral methodology; works with any analytics source, with Clamp MCP as the canonical integration. Use whenever interpreting an in-flight experiment where the planned horizon has not been reached but the user wants a stop/continue decision.
headings: Phase 1. Decide which sequential framework fits
Phase 2. Verify the setup before peeking
Phase 4. Apply confidence sequences (always-valid CI on lift)
Phase 5. Edge cases that break the math
Worked example: mSPRT, mid-flight peek at day 14
Worked example: confidence sequence, ambiguous mid-flight read
skills.description_zh: 用 mSPRT 或置信序列对进行中的 A/B 测试做始终有效的序贯推断，使每日查看仍控制名义假阳性率。用于提前停止、窥探检查、尚未到计划期限的停或继续决策；配合实验读取、贝叶斯读取及诊断法，适用于任意分析来源，Clamp 为典型集成。

skills.name: traffic-change-diagnosis
skills.description: Diagnose why website traffic changed. Use when the user asks "why did traffic drop/spike", investigates an anomaly, or wants to separate tracking regressions from real behaviour changes. Walks a hypothesis tree (measurement → time-shape → channel → cohort → content), recognises common fingerprints (bot spike, tracking regression, deploy-correlated drop, SEO decay, campaign ramp), and applies sample-size discipline.
headings: Fingerprints: common patterns and what they usually mean
skills.description_zh: 沿测量→时间形态→渠道→群体→内容假设树诊断网站流量变化，区分埋点回归与真实行为；识别机器人突增、跟踪回归、发布相关下降、SEO 衰减及活动增长，并遵守样本量约束。
